model_terms: fpocket ships no trained model or checkpoint; pocket detection is a Voronoi/alpha-sphere algorithm, so there are no separate model terms.

bundled_third_party.qhull: src/qhull, released under the Qhull license reproduced in QHULL_COPYING.txt
bundled_third_party.molfile_plugin: plugins/LINUXAMD64/molfile/libmolfile_plugin.a plus the public header plugins/include/molfile_plugin.h; both carry the University of Illinois Board of Trustees copyright notice (UIUC open-source terms), reproduced in the header itself

build: make: builds the bundled qhull static library, then links bin/fpocket (and bin/tpocket, bin/dpocket, which this Runner drops) from gcc plus the in-tree VMD molfile static library. No network access and no external netcdf/GSL is required.
